nodes.label: Lint Job (ruff check)
nodes.rationale: Runs ruff on src and tests to enforce style before merge.

nodes.label: Test Job (pytest matrix)
nodes.rationale: fail-fast is false so all Python versions 3.11-3.14 report even if one fails.

nodes.label: Tokey Live Panel
nodes.rationale: Built because the built-in statusline shows context fullness but never what the last turn spent; the per-prompt cost is the number the author kept wanting to see.

nodes.label: Session Roster Blocks
nodes.rationale: One stacked block per session so a newly-started session just adds a block within a refresh, no restart needed.

nodes.label: Context Fullness Gauge
nodes.rationale: Treated as a gauge not an exact meter; overflow renders like 104%? instead of clamping to 100%, and an unknown model shows 'context limit unknown' rather than a guessed limit.

nodes.label: Last Prompt Line (real-time)
nodes.rationale: The figure the author watches: it flags expensive prompts while you can still change how you ask, instead of finding out at the end. Updates live as the response streams.

nodes.label: Session Total Line
nodes.rationale: A + on the dollar figure flags a partial total when a turn could not be priced; each turn priced with its own model before summing so mixed-model sessions add up correctly.

nodes.label: Baymax Footer Companion
nodes.rationale: Mood and speech-bubble line are paired so they never fall out of step; read from transcript write-recency so it adds no work. --no-mood hides him.

nodes.label: Account-level Usage (tokey cc)
nodes.rationale: Off by default; subscription windows are an opaque server-side percentage not dollars, so tokey shows percent and reset time only. Undocumented endpoint that may change; lookup runs off the render path on a slow refresh and degrades silently.

nodes.label: Live Session Tracking (tokey-hook)
nodes.rationale: Fixes two rough edges of mtime-based liveness (new session invisible until first prompt; exited session reads active for minutes). Pure upgrade: without hooks tokey falls back to transcript-mtime; Windows keeps the fallback.

nodes.label: OAuth Token Read (credentials/Keychain)
nodes.rationale: Reads the token Claude Code already stored (plaintext credentials.json on Linux/WSL, login Keychain on macOS) and sends it only to api.anthropic.com; never writes to the credential store, never reaches a third party.

nodes.label: Windows Two-click Setup
nodes.rationale: setup.bat + Desktop launcher avoid terminal and PATH entirely. Warns against setx PATH, which re-expands %PATH%, can fuse user/system PATH, and truncates past its length limit (corrupted a real PATH in testing).

nodes.label: Single-sourced Version / tokey --version
nodes.rationale: Version single-sourced from cc_token_tracker.__version__; pyproject derives it via setuptools dynamic-version attr so a release bumps one place instead of two.

nodes.label: macOS Keychain OAuth Fallback
nodes.rationale: read_credentials falls back to the login Keychain on macOS via read-only 'security find-generic-password'; the file is tried first so Linux/WSL never invokes security, and every failure degrades to the same 'no usage' path.

nodes.label: UTF-8 Stdout Guard
nodes.rationale: Originally Windows-only for the cp1252 console; now main() forces UTF-8 whenever stdout is not already UTF-8 on any platform, covering bare C/POSIX locales that raised UnicodeEncodeError on the panel's Unicode bars and box characters.

nodes.label: Per-model Pricing Rate Table
nodes.rationale: Built-in rate table keyed on the transcript's model string (cache writes at the 5-minute TTL rate); an unknown model renders $? never $0.00 to avoid silently undercounting.

nodes.label: Per-model Context Limit Table
nodes.rationale: Context fullness estimated from input+cache read+cache creation against a built-in per-model context-limit table; overflow keeps a trailing ? instead of clamping and an unknown model shows ? never a guessed limit.

nodes.label: Direct Transcript Discovery
nodes.rationale: Panel finds the active session by reading the most recently modified transcript under ~/.claude/projects, replacing the earlier statusline shim / pointer-file mechanism; no configuration needed.
